title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SelectiveAccess
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SelectiveAccess. The get operations property-related services typically reference the entire property. However, in the case of certain properties, selective access to only part of the property may be provided. Subclass of oneM2M:OperationInput. SAREF4GRID further specializes this class as EntryDescriptor and RangeDescriptor (documented on their own models).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SelectiveAccess'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
